Claude Code classifiers, progress captions and session-state calls can replace a working session's mapping and pending tool checkpoint, causing the next working turn to replay. This correction gives side calls independent admission, state and retry lifetimes, preserves working checkpoints and recovery authority, and isolates native child identities. Each SDK query now owns its MCP server while working turns retain the same cached tool definitions.

Continues older #1211 in the combined original-creation oldest-first queue through this existing delivery. Actual authored commits from #1211 (`22566e8a`), the original #1231 subset through `50d4a59d`, and #1292 (`21e028a5`) remain incorporated. Expanded #1231 at `5afedf10` is excluded. The complete newer #1283 commit (`571a6716`) is incorporated as `52965e11` only because unchanged candidate production reproduces tool loss on an overlapping MCP connection. It is a dependency of #1211, not a new queue item or delivery PR. All 18 raw contributor Author/AuthorDate/full-message records remain exact and in ancestry for Noah Passalacqua, Aleksey Proshutinskiy and Nowaker; maintainer corrections are separate. Source PRs and #1288 stay open.

Current delivery head: `f9fffd3985f6890a6e3fc5e84a04861115e2fc37`, based on main `11dc1556363ba0b0e5786d999b9fcc30aa169364`. The final commit is documentation only. Production/scripts match certified Linux source image `15f44351`; code/test head `69374acc` changes only the caption concurrency test after that image snapshot.

Validation:

- **Causal SDK MCP transport control:** unchanged baseline loses the second overlapping query's complete catalog and reports `oc failed`, even when the canonical result succeeds. Corrected code has both servers connected with identical complete catalogs and real overlap. Deliberately sharing one server reproduces the baseline cause. Cancellation, pre-request exit42, initialization timeout and TERM-resistant escalation are retained. Seven original attaches and 17 observed original children/iterators/listeners joined; all owned containers/sandboxes removed. SDK 0.2.141/backend 2.1.284 on Linux/x64 with local scripted API, disabled external network and zero credentials/model queries. This proves bounded transport causality, not actual model/client acceptance.
- **Fresh source/package identity:** clean source head15f, all 1,849 tracked source rows and all 432 compiled source/installed files match. Independently installed local tarball SHA256 `9196379796dcc354115dbe0f4772308551e4100d48fa2c703afb1839ffe5e9c0`. First package-qualifier launcher failed before execution because python3 was absent; failure retained, corrected Bun qualifier passes. Original handles joined and owned qualification containers removed.
- **Current actual E55 source and installed:** all 11 original assertions pass on each arm, with three actual Claude Code 2.1.287 client invocations/five real SDK queries each. Exact requested/served Sonnet5-5, SDK 0.2.141, source backend 2.1.284 and installed 2.1.295, Linux/x64. Canonical results, positive usage, capped-tool facts and original process/stdio/iterator/HTTP closure audited. Both attaches/18 observed children joined; task grant, containers and private SDK/runtime files removed after sanitized escrow; supported credential source unchanged. Ten queries cost approximately $0.234818 by SDK estimates. The observer does not record MCP readiness per actual model query. This is not an actual OpenCode/OpenClaw/LiteLLM or historical reporter tuple.
- **Current MCP-corrected E41 source and installed:** all four chain/parallel × JSON/SSE modes pass on both arms at production image15f. Thirty-two real SDK 0.2.141 queries on exact Sonnet5-5/source backend 2.1.284/installed 2.1.295, Linux/x64. Each case verifies three uniquely paired read answers, distinct continuations, unchanged original parent histories, preceding working-session resume, saved-fork follow-up and at least95% cache-prefix reuse. Canonical native results/public history/init/model/positive usage and leader exits agree. All eight original attaches,64 observed children/stdio,SDK/public-history/HTTP resources and16 original matrix-driver children joined. Grant,owned containers/private SDK runtime removed; credential source unchanged. SDK-estimated cost $0.437776. Actor remains an owned OpenCode protocol fixture, not an actual OpenCode/OpenClaw client. No MCP readiness observation per actual inference is claimed. [Current E41 proof and root adversarial review](https://github.com/rynfar/meridian/blob/aae2e280885bd410958a92ea59a60fa1967ea780/docs/maintenance/evidence/1211-mcp-e41-native-20261009/README.md).

Actual Claude Code 2.1.286 E71 main Sonnet5-5/classifier Sonnet5; actual client 2.1.287 foreground E72 main Sonnet5-5; SDK 0.2.141/source backend 2.1.284/installed 2.1.295, Linux/x64. Thirty-eight queries across 12 actual client invocations, SDK-estimated cost $3.616100. E71 request-model ownership, header/shape auxiliary isolation, main resume and zero collisions pass. E72 two parallel foreground Agent children/four exact Bash results, separate resumable mappings, hook custody and bounded leases pass. Both E72 arms retain nine later canonically denied already-handled SDK calls in visible counters. All original attaches/auditors and maintained-harness SDK/client/HTTP/Linux-owned-census/private-runtime witnesses qualify their recorded scope; grant/containers/private qualification removed, source credential unchanged. Four startup rehearsals use a fake grant and zero queries. First rehearsal wrapper used the wrong result label; corrected external audit qualifies the original successful case without rerun. [Current native side-call proof and root adversarial review](https://github.com/rynfar/meridian/blob/f9fffd3985f6890a6e3fc5e84a04861115e2fc37/docs/maintenance/evidence/1211-mcp-sidecalls-native-20261009/README.md).

First full15f attempt stopped with5,761/35/one obsolete caption server-identity assertion; its failure is retained. Correction693 checks separate server objects while preserving working catalog identity and separate caption definitions; corrected42 cases/274 assertions pass. Original handles joined. No material scoped source finding survives. Prior independent reviews keep their explicitly qualified source-only scopes; no new delegation occurred. No exported plugin API change.

[Current sanitized proof, commands, failures, custody receipts, author ledger and root review](https://github.com/rynfar/meridian/blob/4535e09a6f519a5ab4b893c6d097db7b7456bde2/docs/maintenance/evidence/1211-mcp-transport-20261009/README.md). The manifest binds every committed artifact; first failed logs remain alongside passing controls. The owner's checkout/index/status and all12 dirty-file identities remain unchanged. Freshly paginated six-repository queue remains29 PRs/21 issues; older deferrals/no-review/missing-proof holds remain explicit.

Earlier live evidence remains valid **only at its recorded earlier production heads**: source E71 baseline/candidate18-check auto-classifier isolation, source/installed foreground E72 eighteen checks, and all four E41 chain/parallel × JSON/SSE modes on source/installed atd367. Those earlier results cannot establish acceptance of the changed MCP dependency. The current E41 matrix above independently qualifies its bounded scope; current native E71/E72 above independently qualify their explicit current scopes. Historical reporter and broader background/cancellation/caption acceptance remain open. The prior unprofiled store-performance failure and older remote E72 PID-zero failure remain unattributed; passing later runs are not called corrections.

**Merge holds:** background/mixed-auto children, caption and root/scoped/nested cancellation/incidental parent abort; actual historical reporter/client/model/host tuple and gateway; actual native inference MCP readiness; caption baseline discovery/hints0/overlap/abort/cache requirements; broader package parity; older unattributed CI failures; and all required final-head CI including `test`. Keep this PR draft and source reports open. No new PR, merge, source closure, release or community comment.
